rating_definitions.substantial: Coherent historical mechanism with independently validated primary evidence and defensible site reading
rating_definitions.developing: Specific observed evidence and explanation, but at least one primary or physical-evidence gap
rating_definitions.sparse: Single mediated source, disputed date or untested site link
rating_definitions.missing: No defensible archival/physical grounding for proposed field observation
